name: r8_standard_write_037
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();s='''module
public import URMatchingSurvivorGraph
public import URMatchingBase
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Finite
@[expose] public section
namespace URMatching
universe u
variable {V : Type u}

theorem inducedGraph_eq_induce (G : SimpleGraph V) (P : Set V) :
    inducedGraph G P = G.induce P := by
  ext u v
  rfl

theorem degreeBound_iff_standard [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) :
    DegreeBound G d ↔ ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ d := by
  classical
  unfold DegreeBound SimpleGraph.degree
  simp only [SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter]
end URMatching
''';r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingStandardGraph.lean'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
